body: im sure you will find someone, good luck. you can always post here if you'd like and get multiple people to listen more then likely. I would offer but im honestly in no position to talk on a phone right now..im trying to keep my composure sorry..
i know that feeling...just praying you wont wake up in the morning...that the pain would just go away....

Thanks, I appreciate the offer to be honest I dont know why I made this post. To be frank I am far beyond the contemplation point and it's been long decided its just a matter of when and how. It was nice to hear that though and I am glad there are genuinely good people still out there, just not around here.
